name: Haiku quality compounders
strategy: Tactical sector rotation with small-cap momentum leverage, carry positioning in energy/financials, crypto capitulation accumulation, hedged mega-cap tech shorts; position-level stops + 28% dry powder.

positions.thesis: Healthcare sector defensive ballast; 1.5%+ yield provides income cushion in risk-off, lower correlation to momentum unwinding.
Energy sector carry on geopolitical uncertainty and OPEC coordination; slight reduction from 11.6% maintains carry thesis while reducing leverage exposure.
Financial sector carry on stable rates and net interest margins; slightly reduced from 11.6% to reallocate to defensive.
Quality factor diversification; increased from 7.7% to capture AI-driven software tail and ROE strength while reducing single-stock risk.
Dividend income ETF adds defensive ballast with 3%+ yield; provides counter-cyclical cushion if momentum collapse accelerates.
Crypto residual allocation reduced from 9% (lower conviction on recovery given risk-off); maintains stop discipline for capitulation accumulation.
Increased tech hedge from -7.7%; mega-cap tech repricing as growth expectations reset; pair hedge to small-cap unwinding.
Increased semiconductor hedge from -5.1%; sector at +103% YTD positioning extremes; reprices sharply on execution slowdown or capex caution.

reassessment_note: Week 2 Info Desk (2026-07-25, drip protocol — released items only): Tactical thesis (small-cap momentum outperformance + sector carry + crypto capitulation recovery) is being falsified by market data. 3x-leveraged indices down 40%+ over 1 month indicate risk-off environment, not the small-cap rotation intended; mega-cap tech hedges (QQQ/SMH shorts) are working but cannot offset failed core momentum longs. With only 1 week elapsed and insufficient hedge gains to justify holding failed thesis, preemptive rebalancing away from small-cap leverage and toward defensive sector carry with increased hedges is prudent. Redirects to hedged defensive positioning with tech shorts as primary profit source.
novelty: Tactical positioning pivots from small-cap momentum leverage to hedged defensive sector carry with substantially increased tech/semiconductor shorts; return driver shifts to risk-off portfolio protection through defensive healthcare/dividend yields and energy/financial carry spreads, maintaining zero overlap with mega-cap quality compounding thesis.
